verdict.rationale: Jira itself markets agent handoff: work can be assigned to a coding agent from Jira, context can be passed into the AI stack through an official MCP server and CLI, and agents get terminal access to the Teamwork Graph with an audit trail. The evidence is marketing-level, so the claim that handoffs keep context and information intact is not shown in detail. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what context and history transfer during an agent handoff, guarantees against information loss in tool-to-tool handoffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent handoffs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: Assign work to your favorite coding agent from Jira or bring context to your AI stack with our MCP and CLI.
Give AI coding agents terminal access to your Teamwork Graph so they can move from context to action.
Stay in control with an audit trail that keeps teams and agents moving faster and in the same direction.
